ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a very thin square conductor sheet, drawn as an obliquely viewed thin plate shape. At the bottom, a double-headed arrow marks the side length of the square as L, and on the left side, an up-down arrow marks the thickness of the thin plate as t. The parts with diagonal-line shading are two opposite narrow side faces; the size of each shaded face corresponds to L × t, and the conducting distance between them is the other side length L of the square sheet. Reasoning: The resistance formula of a uniform conductor is R = ρl/A. The current flows from one shaded side face to the opposite shaded side face, so the conducting length l = L; the cross-sectional area perpendicular to the direction of current is A = L t. Therefore R = ρL/(Lt) = ρ/t. In the expression, L is canceled, so the resistance is unrelated to L.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中是一个很薄的正方形导体片，底部标出正方形边长为 L，左侧竖直方向标出厚度为 t；带斜线阴影的是两块相对的窄侧面，每个阴影面的尺寸可读为 L × t，它们之间的导电距离是另一条边长 L。再结合题干给出的材料电阻率 ρ，用均匀导体电阻公式 R = ρl/A。这里电流从一个阴影侧面流到相对阴影侧面，路径长度 l = L，横截面积 A = Lt，因此 R = ρL/(Lt) = ρ/t。结果中 L 消去，所以电阻与 L 无关。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一块很薄的正方形导体片，画成斜视的薄板形状。底部用双向箭头标出正方形边长为 L，左侧用上下箭头标出薄板厚度为 t。带斜线阴影的是两块相对的窄侧面，每块阴影面的尺寸对应为 L × t，它们之间相隔的导电距离是正方形片的另一条边长 L。
推理：均匀导体的电阻公式为 R = ρl/A。电流从一个阴影侧面流到相对阴影侧面，因此导电长度 l = L；垂直于电流方向的截面积 A = L t。所以 R = ρL/(Lt) = ρ/t。表达式中 L 被消去，因此电阻与 L 无关。
